llm.evidence: We illustrate this protocol with ECMs obtained from two pairs of tissues, which differ in ECM content and cellularity: triple-negative breast cancer and adjacent mammary tissue, and omental metastasis from high-grade serous ovarian cancer and normal omentum.
Patient samples were kindly donated by women with high-grade serous ovarian cancer (HGSOC; n = 2) or triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC; n = 2)
